title: Stall & pickup
intro: What customers see about your stall, the markets you sell at, your operating days and pickup windows, and where the stall is on the map.

details.title: Stall details
details.phoneHint: Shown to customers on their order ticket.
details.aboutHint: Shown in handwriting on your stall page. One or two sentences.

cutoff.title: Order cutoff
cutoff.label: Stop taking changes this many hours before the pickup slot
cutoff.hint_one: For a {{slot}} slot on {{saturday}}, {{count}} hour means {{time}} on {{day}}. Customers cannot edit or cancel after that, and new orders for that slot close too (D-05).
cutoff.hint_other: For a {{slot}} slot on {{saturday}}, {{count}} hours means {{time}} on {{day}}. Customers cannot edit or cancel after that, and new orders for that slot close too (D-05).

markets.title: Markets you sell at
markets.intro: Tick a market to open its settings. Days and pickup windows are set per market.
markets.codeHint: Shown on the order ticket so customers find you.
markets.mapLabel: Pin the stall on the map
markets.mapHint: Drag the round pin to your spot inside the market. The square pin is the market itself.
markets.pinMovedText: Pin moved to the market entrance. Drag it to your spot.
markets.savedText: Markets, days and pickup windows saved. Slots for next week follow the new windows.
